experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
bullets: Build across Shopify Checkout and Checkout Extensibility, including Shopify Functions, Checkout UI extensions and Shop Pay, connecting the buyer transaction with the commerce data and intelligence used across the purchase lifecycle.

Engineer Shopify Functions within the checkout execution path, turning cart and buyer context into controlled discount, delivery and payment decisions while Shopify retains ownership of the underlying transaction.

Develop the commerce-event path around Checkout, carrying buyer, cart and order activity into downstream processing so transaction history can support operational workflows, analytics and intelligent decisions.
Build the intelligence path around Checkout, turning buyer, cart and order history into signals for fraud and risk decisions, personalization, experimentation and merchant-facing insights.

experience.title: Founding Software Engineer
bullets: Built the first version of Felix's online care platform as a founding engineer, taking a patient from intake questionnaire through clinician review to a prescription order ahead of the public launch.

Developed the clinician review tooling that let licensed physicians assess each intake, approve or decline treatment and message the patient, replacing the email and phone follow-up the first cases ran on.

Integrated prescription orders with pharmacy fulfilment and discreet home delivery, so an approved treatment moved from the clinician's decision to a shipped package without anyone re-entering the order.
Implemented recurring treatment subscriptions and payments, handling refills, plan changes and failed charges so returning patients kept their medication without restarting the intake.
Hardened how the platform handled personal health information as the service grew across provinces, adding access controls and audit trails around every clinician and pharmacy action.

experience.title: Software Engineer

Developed commerce data synchronisation between store point of sale and headquarters, so price, product and inventory changes reached every store without waiting on an overnight batch.
Implemented payment connector support for in-store and online payments, handling authorisations, voids and refunds so a failed card transaction never left an order half-completed.
Diagnosed performance and reliability defects in the retail server under peak trading load, reducing the checkout slowdowns store associates saw during the busiest periods.
Wrote unit and integration tests and joined the team's servicing rotation, tracing customer-reported retail issues to root cause and shipping the fixes in regular product updates.
